Excellent
Sep 2026 • Family
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A wonderful experience with steak in Nha Trang

I had a very enjoyable evening with my family at EMBER Steakhouse Nha Trang. The restaurant has a beautiful, spacious atmosphere and a very convenient location on Tran Phu street, right near the beach. Spacious, comfortable, very suitable for dinners with friends, family, or a romantic evening.

The steak is really delicious — tender, juicy, perfectly seasoned, and cooked to the right doneness. I also really like side dishes and sauces, which combine very harmoniously with steak. The menu has many diverse options, from seafood to pasta, so everyone can easily find their favorite dish.

Friendly, enthusiastic staff who are always ready to advise on dishes. The service was generally very attentive and professional throughout the meal.

Overall, I rate EMBER as having good food quality, a beautiful space, and a convenient location at a reasonable price. This is definitely a steakhouse worth trying when you come to Nha Trang.

I will definitely come back again! 🥩🔥🍷
